items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) found that conservative interventions significantly reduced pain (SMD = −0.67) and disability (SMD = −0.60) in degenerative cervical spine disease. Acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showed significant benefits, while manual therapy did not show a significant pooled benefit. Evidence certainty was low.
items.curatedReason: 对于退行性颈椎病，保守治疗确实能改善疼痛和残疾（SMD分别达到-0.67和-0.60）。目前证据提示，针灸和运动疗法有明确益处，但手法治疗的合b并益处不显著。鉴于证据质量较低，你可以优先考虑将运动和针灸纳入治疗方案，但对单纯手法治疗的预期需保持审慎。
items.titleZh: 保守干预措施对退行性颈椎病疼痛和残疾的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项 RCT（2,378 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，保守干预措施能显著减轻退行性颈椎病的疼痛 (SMD = −0.67) 和残疾 (SMD = −0.60)。针灸和运动疗法显示出显著益处，而手法治疗未显示显著的汇总益处。证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Conservative interventions do reduce pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease (SMDs of -0.67 and -0.60, respectively). Current evidence suggests clear benefits from acupuncture and exercise-based therapies, but manual therapy did not show a significant pooled benefit. Given the low certainty of evidence, you can prioritize incorporating exercise and acupuncture, but temper expectations for manual therapy alone.
items.limitation: 本综述存在显著异质性（I² = 87.20%），且证据确定性较低，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This review exhibits substantial heterogeneity (I² = 87.20%) and low certainty of evidence, which may affect the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (1,177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49), but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI was associated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). Population type moderated the effects of training on Cw (p=0.043).
items.curatedReason: 慢性运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本（g=0.49），但在卒中患者中，其改善效果并不显著（g=0.24, p=0.065）。此外，BMI越高，训练对步行代谢成本的改善效果越小（β=-0.20）。这意味着，在健康人群中，运动训练是提高步行效率的有效手段；而对于卒中患者，其效益可能较小，且肥胖会进一步削弱这种效果，设计方案时务必考虑这些差异。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项研究（1,177 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，慢性体力运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本 (g=0.49)，但在卒中患者中无显著改善 (g=0.24, p=0.065)。较高的 BMI 与步行代谢成本干预效果较小相关 (β=-0.20)。人群类型调节了训练对步行代谢成本的影响 (p=0.043)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49) but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI also correlated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). This means exercise training is effective for improving walking economy in healthy populations, but its benefits might be smaller for stroke patients, and obesity further attenuates this effect. Be sure to consider these differences when designing intervention plans.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究存在中度异质性，且卒中、多发性硬化症、帕金森病等神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This review includes studies with moderate heterogeneity, and the sample sizes for neurological conditions like stroke, MS, and Parkinson's disease are relatively small.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that adherence to home-based exercise therapy was 45%, with no significant influence of supervision. Higher baseline physical activity, lower pain intensity, and lower treatment burden were associated with higher adherence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了慢性非特异性腰痛患者居家运动治疗依从性仅为 45%，并且未发现监督能显著提高依从性。这提示您在设计居家方案时，需要更关注患者物理活动水平、疼痛强度和治疗负担等因素。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：一项包含 491 名参与者的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人进行的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。研究未能证实监督对依从性的显著影响，但较高的基础体力活动水平、较低的疼痛强度和治疗负担与较高的依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that adherence to home-based exercise therapy in non-specific chronic low back pain is only 45%, with no significant influence of supervision. This suggests that when designing home programs, you need to consider factors like baseline physical activity, pain intensity, and treatment burden more closely.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A scoping review of 80 randomized controlled trials on continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers found most studies included only patients and focused on the transition from inpatient to home care. It highlighted the need for more family-centered interventions that include both patients and caregivers and address all transitions across the stroke care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的连续性照护干预研究应更多地纳入患者及其照护者，并从家庭中心角度考量。这提示您在设计卒中康复方案时，应将照护者视为核心，并关注急性期后向居家过渡的连续性支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者及其照护者连续性照护干预的范围综述：随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入 80 项随机对照试验，发现大多数卒中连续性照护干预研究仅纳入患者，并侧重于从住院到居家照护的过渡。综述强调，未来的干预研究应同时纳入卒中患者及其照护者，并采取以家庭为中心的方法，解决卒中全程护理的各种过渡需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Continuity of care interventions for stroke patients should involve both patients and caregivers, adopting a family-centered approach. This indicates that when designing stroke rehabilitation plans, you should consider caregivers as central and focus on continuous support during the transition from acute care to home.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能进行荟萃分析，无法量化干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that did not include meta-analysis, so it cannot quantify intervention effects.

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 11 adults aged 50+ with mobility or sensory impairments identified multidimensional barriers to participation in community-based fall prevention exercise programs. Themes included lack of awareness/access, interconnected accessibility challenges, disability experiences, and program design issues. Rebranding and co-designing inclusive, flexible programs are suggested.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示，社区跌倒预防运动项目在吸引老年残疾人群时面临多维度障碍，包括污名化、项目错位和自我刻板印象。您在设计或推广此类项目时，应考虑重新品牌定位，并采用共创设计以提升包容性和参与度。
items.titleZh: “这不适合我”：针对步入残疾老龄化人群的社区跌倒预防运动项目
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 11 名 50 岁以上有行动或感觉障碍成年人的定性研究发现，社区跌倒预防运动项目面临多维度参与障碍，包括认知度不足、可及性挑战、残疾经验和项目设计问题。研究建议重新品牌定位并共创设计包容性、灵活的项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that community-based fall prevention exercise programs face multidimensional barriers in attracting older adults with disabilities, including stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping. When designing or promoting such programs, you should consider rebranding and using co-design processes to foster inclusion and participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性设计，样本量小（11名参与者），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (11 participants), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A prospective two-phase feasibility study found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation program for COPD was technically feasible (device data agreement ≥99%) and clinically feasible (95% retention, high satisfaction). Exploratory outcomes showed increased endurance time.
items.curatedReason: 远程肺康复（PR）模式在技术和临床上均可行，设备数据传输准确，患者满意度高。这提示您在 COPD 患者康复中可考虑将远程康复作为可行方案，但大规模随机对照研究仍需进一步验证其临床疗效。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性两阶段可行性研究发现，针对慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者的居家肺部远程康复项目在技术上（设备数据一致性 ≥99%）和临床上（95% 留存率、高满意度）均可行。探索性结果显示患者耐力时间增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that a pulmonary telerehabilitation (PR) model is both technically and clinically feasible, with accurate data transmission and high patient satisfaction. This suggests you can consider telerehabilitation as a viable option for COPD patient rehabilitation, though larger randomized controlled studies are needed to further assess its clinical efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组进行疗效评估。
items.limitationEn: This was a feasibility study with a small sample size and lacked a control group for efficacy evaluation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Predictive value of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex monitoring for postoperative voiding dysfunction after lumbosacral spine surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring found it feasible (94% success rate) and predictive of postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. BCR showed moderate sensitivity (62%) and high specificity (99%), with a high negative predictive value of 94% for POVD.
items.curatedReason: 术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍（POVD）具有高特异性和阴性预测值。这提示您在参与腰骶椎术前评估和术后康复计划时，可将 BCR 监测结果作为辅助参考，识别 POVD 高风险患者，并协助制定个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 术中球海绵体反射监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍的预测价值：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项关于术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，该方法可行（成功率 94%），且能预测腰骶椎手术后的排尿功能障碍（POVD）。BCR 对 POVD 表现出中度敏感性（62%）和高特异性（99%），阴性预测值为 94%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring shows high specificity and negative predictive value for postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. This suggests that when participating in pre- and post-operative rehabilitation planning for lumbosacral spine surgery, you can use BCR monitoring results as an auxiliary reference to identify high-risk POVD patients and help develop individualized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限，且研究间存在异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of RCTs included and the heterogeneity among studies may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 knee/hip osteoarthritis patients found that 58.5% reached recommended physical activity levels after digital education and exercise therapy. Four physical activity trajectories were identified, with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed clinically comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 数字化教育和运动疗法能使约 60% 的膝/髋骨关节炎患者达到或维持推荐的体力活动水平，且不同体力活动轨迹的患者在患者报告结局（PROs）上均有可比的改善。这提示您在 OA 管理中，应持续推广数字化教育与运动疗法，并可针对 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者制定个性化策略。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项包含 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，经过数字化教育和运动疗法后，58.5% 的患者达到了推荐的体力活动水平。研究识别出四种体力活动轨迹，其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局均有临床可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Digital education and exercise therapy enabled about 60% of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients to achieve or maintain recommended physical activity levels, with comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes (PROs) across different physical activity trajectories. This suggests that in OA management, you should continue to promote digital education and exercise therapy, and tailor strategies for patients with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，不能排除混杂因素对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational cohort study, and confounding factors influencing the results cannot be excluded.

related.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy-a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis.

items.title: Return to Competition and Career Sustainability After Primary ACL Reconstruction in Football: A Nationwide Cohort Study of Long-Term Participation
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of 10,836 football players after primary ACLR found a 58.5% return to competition (RTC) rate. Post-RTC career sustainability (median 31 matches over 3 seasons) was greatest among top-level players (97 matches over 5 seasons) and men (33 matches over 4 seasons vs. women's 29 matches over 3 seasons). RTC alone provides an incomplete description of participation.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员在初次 ACLR 术后重返赛场（RTC）率达 58.5%，但职业生涯持续性因竞技水平和性别而异。这提示您在 ACLR 康复中，RTC 并非终点，应关注术后长期参与度，并根据患者的竞技水平和性别制定差异化的重返运动及职业可持续性策略。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返赛场及职业生涯可持续性：一项全国性长期参与队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10,836 名足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后的全国性队列研究发现，重返赛场 (RTC) 率为 58.5%。RTC 后职业生涯可持续性（中位数 3 个赛季 31 场比赛）在顶级水平运动员（5 个赛季 97 场比赛）和男性（4 个赛季 33 场比赛对比女性 3 个赛季 29 场比赛）中最高。RTC 本身不能完全描述长期参与度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The return to competition (RTC) rate after primary ACLR in football players is 58.5%, but career sustainability varies by competitive level and sex. This suggests that in ACLR rehabilitation, RTC is not the endpoint; you should focus on long-term participation and tailor return-to-sport and career sustainability strategies based on the player's competitive level and sex.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: A review of physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain, providing insights for clinical practice.
items.curatedReason: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗手段仍在发展。这篇综述从多维度更新了该领域的证据，值得你花时间梳理，用以优化你的临床治疗方案和拓宽干预思路。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理，为临床实践提供了新的视角和干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapy for persistent pelvic pain is an evolving field. This review updates the evidence from multiple dimensions; it's worth your time to review it to optimize your clinical treatment plans and broaden intervention strategies.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that stroke caregiver assessments inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH). Most studies only assessed subjective financial strain or limited NMDOH domains. Future instruments should integrate multidimensional financial toxicity and NMDOH measures with caregiver role formation.
items.curatedReason: 当前卒中照护者评估在财务负担和非医疗健康因素方面存在不足。您在评估卒中照护者能力时，应考虑纳入多维度的财务毒性和更全面的非医疗健康因素，以识别脆弱性并提供公平支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期照护角色形成中的财务负担、非医疗健康因素：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究的范围综述发现，卒中照护者评估未能一致地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康决定因素。大多数研究仅评估主观财务压力或有限的非医疗健康领域。未来的评估工具应整合多维度的财务毒性和非医疗健康措施，并结合照护者角色形成。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current stroke caregiver assessments are inadequate regarding financial burden and non-medical drivers of health. When evaluating stroke caregiver capacity, you should consider including multidimensional financial toxicity and more comprehensive non-medical health factors to identify vulnerabilities and provide equitable support.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，无法量化具体影响或提供干预效果的比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review and cannot quantify specific impacts or compare intervention effectiveness.

items.title: The effect of adding virtual reality-based rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy on pain, function and static balance control in patients with total knee arthroplasty during the acute rehabilitation phase: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=52) found that adding VR-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy after total knee arthroplasty significantly improved WOMAC scores and pain at post-treatment and one-month follow-up (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36), and static balance (p < 0.001, η² = 0.23 for mediolateral mean velocity) compared to conventional therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 在全膝关节置换术（TKA）的急性康复期，虚拟现实（VR）疗法能额外改善患者的疼痛、功能和静态平衡。这提示您可考虑将 VR 引入 TKA 术后早期康复方案，作为传统物理治疗的补充。
items.titleZh: 在全膝关节置换术急性康复期，将虚拟现实康复加入常规物理治疗对疼痛、功能和静态平衡控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=52）发现，在全膝关节置换术后，与单独的常规物理治疗相比，在常规物理治疗中加入基于虚拟现实的疗法能显著改善治疗后和一个月随访时的 WOMAC 评分和疼痛（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36），以及静态平衡（p < 0.001, 内外侧平均速度 η² = 0.23）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality (VR) therapy can provide additional benefits in pain, function, and static balance during the acute rehabilitation phase following total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This suggests you might consider incorporating VR into early post-TKA rehabilitation programs as a supplement to conventional physiotherapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心小样本研究（52 名患者），随访期短，且未评估长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a small sample size (52 patients), short follow-up, and did not assess long-term efficacy.

items.title: Promoting arm movement practice with a novel wheelchair armrest early after stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=35) found that a novel wheelchair-mounted rehabilitation device, Boost, was feasible and allowed stroke inpatients to complete thousands of unsupervised upper extremity movements. While no significant between-group clinical differences were found at 3-month follow-up, the Boost group showed a trend toward greater UEFM improvement immediately post-intervention (11.8 vs. 6.9 points, p = 0.06), especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.curatedReason: 新型轮椅扶手辅助设备 Boost 在卒中早期住院康复中能促进患者完成数千次上肢运动，对轻度损伤患者短期效果更佳。这提示您可考虑引入此类设备，增加患者在无直接监督下的运动量，从而优化康复效率，尤其对于损伤程度较轻的患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中早期使用新型轮椅扶手辅助促进手臂运动训练：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=35）发现，新型轮椅辅助康复设备 Boost 在卒中住院患者中可行，并使其在无监督下完成数千次上肢运动。虽然 3 个月随访时未发现显著的组间临床差异，但 Boost 组在干预后上肢 Fugl-Meyer 评分有更大改善趋势（11.8 vs. 6.9 分, p = 0.06），尤其对轻度损伤患者更明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: The novel wheelchair armrest device, Boost, can facilitate thousands of upper extremity movements in early post-stroke inpatient rehabilitation, with better short-term outcomes for less severely impaired patients. This suggests you could consider incorporating such devices to increase patient exercise volume without direct supervision, optimizing rehabilitation efficiency, especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（35 名患者），随访期短，且未达到显著的组间临床差异，尚需更大规模 RCT 验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (35 patients), short follow-up, and did not achieve significant between-group clinical differences, necessitating validation in larger RCTs.

items.title: Extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma analytes in clinical research
items.summary: This study explores extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma enzymes in ambulatory inpatients with Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophies. It found that enzyme levels increased after physical activity and then decreased, suggesting muscle damage and subsequent clearance, which could indicate sarcolemma fragility.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，肌源性血浆酶的时间序列分析可能为肌萎缩症患者的肌膜脆性和肌肉损伤提供有价值的指标。这提示您在评估患者时，未来或许可以通过动态生物标志物来补充传统的功能评估。
items.titleZh: 从肌萎缩症患者血浆分析物时间序列分析中提取有意义的特征
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探索了从肢带型肌营养不良症住院患者血浆酶时间序列分析中提取有意义的特征。研究发现，体力活动后酶水平升高随后下降，提示肌肉损伤和随后的清除，这可能指示肌膜脆性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that time series analysis of muscle-derived plasma enzymes could provide valuable indicators for sarcolemma fragility and muscle damage in muscular dystrophies. This implies that in the future, you might be able to supplement traditional functional assessments with dynamic biomarker analysis when evaluating patients.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量未明确提及，且为初步的机制探索，结论需在临床大样本中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The sample size for this study was not clearly mentioned, and as a preliminary mechanistic exploration, its conclusions need further validation in larger clinical cohorts.

items.title: Effects of training with a soft wearable robot (Myosuit®) on the walking ability of patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: A randomized controlled study (N=30) found that gait training using Myosuit®, a soft wearable robot, did not show overall significant differences compared to a control group in chronic stroke patients. However, subgroup analysis showed significant improvements in the 10-m walking test, Berg balance scale, and gait velocity for Myosuit® users with better baseline gait function (FAC 4).
items.curatedReason: 使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练可能对慢性卒中、且步态功能较好的患者的步态功能有改善作用。这提示您在引入康复机器人时，应考虑患者的基线步态功能水平，以实现更精准的干预。
items.titleZh: 使用软性可穿戴机器人（Myosuit®）训练对慢性卒中患者步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照研究（N=30）发现，与对照组相比，使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练对慢性卒中患者总体上未显示显著差异。然而，亚组分析显示，基线步态功能较好（FAC 4）的 Myosuit® 使用者在 10 米步行测试、Berg 平衡量表和步速方面有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gait training with the soft wearable robot Myosuit® may improve gait function in chronic stroke patients with better baseline gait function. This suggests that when introducing rehabilitation robots, you should consider patients' baseline gait function levels for more precise interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（30 名患者），且总体结果未见显著差异，仅在亚组分析中显示出效应。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (30 patients), showed no significant overall differences, and only revealed effects in subgroup analysis.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series of 100 patients after QT-ACLR showed that early 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9; Adj R² = 0.36; P < .03), with patients achieving PASS typically reaching a 60%-70% LSI by 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 对于 QT-ACLR 术后患者，早期等长股四头肌 LSI 值是 2 年 IKDC 评分的强预测因子。这条观察性研究提示，3 个月时能达到 60%-70% LSI 的患者，更有可能在两年后获得满意的功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数与 2 年患者报告结局的相关性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 例股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建患者的病例系列研究显示，术后 3 个月早期等长股四头肌肢体对称性指数（LSI）能强力预测 2 年 IKDC 评分（β = 3.9; 校正 R² = 0.36; P < .03），达到患者可接受症状状态（PASS）的患者通常在 3 个月时 LSI 达到 60%-70%。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients post-QT-ACLR, early isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicts 2-year IKDC scores. This observational study suggests that achieving 60%-70% LSI by 3 months is associated with a greater likelihood of satisfactory functional recovery at two years.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性病例系列，可能存在选择偏倚，且随访时长中位数 2 年。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective case series, which may introduce selection bias, and the median follow-up duration was 2 years.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=75) on post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome found that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises produced significantly greater improvements in nerve conduction velocity, CMAP amplitudes, and DASH scores compared to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) or exercises alone, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up (all P < .001).
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验明确指出，联合尺神经滑行训练，高强度激光治疗（HILT）在改善烧伤后肘管综合征的电生理和功能结局方面优于体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）。该证据支持您在临床实践中，对于此类患者优先考虑 HILT 治疗。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光治疗与体外冲击波治疗的电生理及功能反应比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对烧伤后肘管综合征的随机对照试验（n=75）发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合尺神经滑行训练在神经传导速度、复合肌肉动作电位幅度和 DASH 评分方面，比体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）或单纯运动治疗产生显著更大的改善，且益处在 12 周随访时仍保持（所有 P < .001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial clearly indicates that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT), combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises, is superior to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) in improving electrophysiological and functional outcomes for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. This evidence supports prioritizing HILT for such patients in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，随访期仅为 12 周，长期效果尚需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center trial with a follow-up period of only 12 weeks, so long-term effects require further evidence.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 97 adolescent patients found that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 was associated with a 3.56 odds ratio (95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033) for successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery.
items.curatedReason: ACL-RSI 量表对髌骨稳定术后青少年患者能否成功重返运动具有预测价值，总分 ≥59.2 是成功的预测因素。这提示您在术后康复中，除了身体功能，应将患者的心理准备状态纳入评估。
items.titleZh: 心理准备程度能否预测青少年髌骨稳定术后成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 97 名青少年患者的回顾性队列研究发现，ACL-RSI 评分 ≥59.2 与髌骨稳定术后成功重返运动的几率增加（比值比 3.56；95% CI，1.10-11.51；P = .033）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ACL-RSI scale has predictive value for successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescent patients, with a score ≥59.2 indicating success. This suggests you should integrate the patient's psychological readiness into your postoperative rehabilitation assessment, beyond just physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且为单中心研究，结果可能存在选择偏倚和外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study was conducted at a single institution, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 Austrian physiotherapists identified that while informal direct access is common, barriers to formal implementation include concerns about red-flag screening, legal uncertainty, and interprofessional relationships, highlighting needs for targeted training.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究揭示了奥地利物理治疗师对直接就诊的看法，指出了在现有转诊体系下，尽管存在非正式的直接就诊实践，但在红旗征象筛查、法律责任和医患关系方面仍有培训需求和组织障碍。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊体系中物理治疗师对直接就诊的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名奥地利物理治疗师的定性研究发现，尽管非正式的直接就诊已存在，但正式实施的障碍包括对红旗征象筛查、法律不确定性和医患关系的担忧，凸显了定向培训的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals Austrian physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, indicating that while informal direct access exists within the referral system, there are still training needs and organizational barriers related to red-flag screening, legal liability, and physician-patient relationships.

items.title: Using Patient-Centered Outcomes Data to Support Reciprocal Learning and Improve Rehabilitation Care
items.summary: This commentary highlights the critical need for transparency and clear communication among rehabilitation team members when utilizing patient-centered outcomes (PCO) data to inform individual care and guide health system-level learning, emphasizing challenges in systematic implementation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论强调了利用以患者为中心的结果（PCO）数据来改进康复护理的关键性，但指出系统性实施面临挑战。它提示你，透明化团队沟通和明确数据使用目的，是优化康复结果和促进系统学习的重要途径。
items.titleZh: 利用以患者为中心的结果数据支持互惠学习和改善康复护理
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论强调，在利用以患者为中心的结果（PCO）数据来指导个体护理和健康系统层面的学习时，康复团队成员之间需保持透明和清晰的沟通，并指出系统性实施面临挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary emphasizes the criticality of using Patient-Centered Outcomes (PCO) data to improve rehabilitation care but notes challenges in systematic implementation. It suggests that transparent team communication and clear objectives for data use are crucial for optimizing rehabilitation outcomes and fostering system-level learning.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 South African physiotherapists found that self-management for chronic non-specific low back pain requires a biopsychosocial approach, incorporating patient beliefs, social factors, and interprofessional teamwork.
items.curatedReason: 这项南非定性研究突出了生物心理社会模型在慢性非特异性腰痛自我管理中的重要性。它提醒你，文化背景、社会因素和多专业协作在患者照护中不可或缺，尤其是在资源受限的环境中。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师对慢性非特异性腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对21名南非物理治疗师的定性研究发现，慢性非特异性腰痛的自我管理需要整合患者信念、社会因素和多专业团队合作的生物心理社会方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study from South Africa highlights the importance of the biopsychosocial model in chronic non-specific low back pain self-management. It reminds you that cultural context, social factors, and interprofessional collaboration are indispensable in patient care, especially in resource-limited settings.

items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (21 PTs) and its generalizability is limited, being specific to the context of Limpopo province, South Africa.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Clarifying 'youth: why conceptual and ethical clarity matters in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights the conceptual and ethical issues arising from the variable terminology used to define 'youth' athletes in sport, arguing that adopted labels carry embedded assumptions about capacities, rights, and risks.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论呼吁在运动领域对“青少年”的定义达成共识，提醒你在评估和管理年轻运动员时，需考虑不同术语可能带来的能力、权利和风险假设。
items.titleZh: 明确“青少年”：为什么概念和伦理清晰性在运动中很重要
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论强调了运动中定义“青少年”运动员的术语多变所引发的概念和伦理问题，认为所采用的标签隐含了对能力、权利和风险的假设。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial calls for definitional clarity around “youth” in sport, reminding you to consider the assumptions about capacities, rights, and risks that different terminologies might carry when assessing and managing young athletes.

items.title: Championing choice: the Womens Tennis Association Fertility Protection Programme for professional women tennis players
items.summary: This editorial highlights the Women's Tennis Association's Fertility Protection Programme for professional female tennis players, addressing distinct barriers to high-performance sport across their lifespan, including fertility preservation and return-to-sport challenges.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论介绍了女子网球协会（WTA）的生育保护计划，揭示了女运动员面临的独特生育挑战和支持需求。这让你在照护女运动员时，要将生育保存和育儿支持纳入整体考量。
items.titleZh: 倡导选择：女子网球协会（WTA）职业女网运动员生育保护计划
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论重点介绍了女子网球协会为职业女网运动员提供的生育保护计划，旨在解决她们在运动生涯中面临的独特障碍，包括生育保存和重返赛场的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial introduces the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) Fertility Protection Programme, revealing the unique fertility challenges and support needs of female athletes. This should prompt you to integrate fertility preservation and parental support into holistic care for female athletes.

items.title: 'Written in English: has English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport become a barrier to creating culturally and contextually situated mental health care?
items.summary: This commentary argues that English dominance in sport and parasport mental health research (98% of studies) may hinder culturally and contextually situated mental healthcare, advocating for greater linguistic inclusivity.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论提出英语作为体育和残疾人体育心理健康研究的通用语言，可能阻碍了文化和情境适宜的心理健康护理。这提示你，应关注语言障碍对知识传播的影响，思考如何在实践中促进更具包容性的交流。
items.titleZh: “用英文书写”：英语作为体育和残疾人体育心理健康研究的通用语言是否已成为创建文化和情境适宜心理健康护理的障碍？
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论指出，英语在体育和残疾人体育心理健康研究中的主导地位（98%的研究）可能阻碍了文化和情境适宜的心理健康护理，因此倡导更大的语言包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that English as the lingua franca in sport and parasport mental health research may hinder culturally and contextually appropriate mental health care. This should prompt you to consider the impact of language barriers on knowledge dissemination and how to foster more inclusive communication in your practice.

items.title: Implementation gap: a 3-year reality check in body composition monitoring in sport
items.summary: This editorial addresses the implementation gap in body composition monitoring in sport, three years after the International Olympic Committee's recommendations on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs) were published, advocating for better translation of evidence into practice.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论指出，国际奥委会关于运动员身体成分监测的建议发布三年后，实践中仍存在实施差距。它提醒你，要主动将最新的证据转化为日常实践，尤其是在预防REDs（运动性相对能量不足综合征）和促进运动员健康方面。
items.titleZh: 实施差距：运动中身体成分监测的三年现实检查
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了运动中身体成分监测的实施差距，指出国际奥委会关于运动性相对能量不足综合征（REDs）的建议发布三年后，实践中仍存在不足，呼吁更好地将证据转化为实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights an implementation gap in body composition monitoring recommendations for athletes three years after the IOC Consensus Statement. It reminds you to actively translate the latest evidence into daily practice, especially in preventing REDs (Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport) and promoting athlete health.

items.title: 'Avoid vigorous exercise until further notice: recovery after cholesteatoma surgery
items.summary: This commentary reflects on an amateur powerlifter's experience with vague post-cholesteatoma surgery restrictions, highlighting the lack of clear timelines or explanations for 'avoid vigorous exercise' and its impact on mental and physical well-being.
items.curatedReason: 这篇个人故事探讨了运动员在胆脂瘤手术后，对“避免剧烈运动”指令的困惑和不确定性。这提醒你在给出术后或损伤恢复建议时，必须提供清晰、具体且有时间线的指导，并与患者共同决策，以满足他们的个人需求和目标。
items.titleZh: “在进一步通知前避免剧烈运动”：胆脂瘤手术后的康复
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论反映了一名业余举重运动员在胆脂瘤手术后对“避免剧烈运动”这一模糊限制的经历，强调了缺乏明确时间表或解释对身心健康的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This personal account explores an athlete's confusion and uncertainty regarding the 'avoid vigorous exercise' instruction after cholesteatoma surgery. This reminds you that when providing post-operative or injury recovery advice, you must offer clear, specific, and time-bound guidance, and engage in shared decision-making with patients to meet their individual needs and goals.

items.title: Influence of shoulder strength on throwing velocity in handball (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD study developed a functional shoulder dynamogram to define how comprehensive shoulder strength profiles influence throwing velocity in handball players, assessing the reliability of novel measurement protocols and exploring the capacity of specific concentric and eccentric muscle actions to predict performance.
items.curatedReason: 在评估手球运动员投掷速度时，别只看整体力量，这份博士研究提示我们需要关注肩关节特定向心和离心肌肉活动的预测能力。这意味着你可以用它开发更精细的生物力学评估和针对性训练方案。
items.titleZh: 肩部力量对手球投掷速度的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士研究开发了一种功能性肩关节动力图，旨在界定全面的肩部力量特征如何影响手球运动员的投掷速度，评估新型测量方案的可靠性，并探索特定向心和离心肌肉活动预测表现的能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing handball throwing velocity, don't just look at overall strength. This PhD study suggests specific concentric and eccentric shoulder muscle actions predict performance. Use this to develop more refined biomechanical assessments and targeted training programs.
items.limitation: 这是一项博士研究的摘要，具体数据和方法细节有限，需要查阅完整论文以全面评估其结论和适用性。
items.limitationEn: This is an abstract of a PhD study with limited specific data and methodological details, requiring access to the full thesis for a comprehensive evaluation of its conclusions and applicability.

items.title: Sex differences in performance fatigability: evidence from a maximal intermittent protocol using a flywheel device (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD study investigated sex differences in performance fatigability mechanisms after a maximal intermittent fatiguing protocol using a flywheel device, examining changes in performance decline, voluntary muscle activity, and electrically-evoked mechanical/electromyographical variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究提示，男女在最大间歇性疲劳后的表现疲劳机制存在差异。这意味着在设计训练和康复方案时，必须考虑生物性别对疲劳反应的影响，以实现更个性化的干预。
items.titleZh: 表现疲劳的性别差异：来自使用飞轮设备的最大间歇协议的证据（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士研究调查了使用飞轮设备的最大间歇疲劳协议后，表现疲劳机制的性别差异，检查了表现下降、自主肌肉活动以及电诱发机械/肌电变量的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD study suggests there are sex differences in performance fatigability mechanisms after maximal intermittent fatigue. This means you must consider biological sex when designing training and rehabilitation programs to ensure individualized interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项博士研究的摘要，具体数据和方法细节有限，需要查阅完整论文以全面评估其结论和适用性。
items.limitationEn: This is an abstract of a PhD study with limited specific data and methodological details, requiring access to the full thesis for a comprehensive evaluation of its conclusions and applicability.

items.title: Development of an upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD thesis aimed to propose a stakeholder-informed upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework to enhance clinician/researcher and athlete interaction, addressing gaps in literature and clinical challenges by comprehensively assessing pain through a biopsychosocial lens.

items.summaryZh: 一项博士论文旨在提出一个由利益相关者参与制定的上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架，以加强临床医生/研究人员与运动员的互动，通过生物心理社会视角全面评估疼痛，从而填补文献空白并解决临床挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research developed an upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework to enhance clinician-athlete interaction and comprehensively assess pain. This provides you with a systematic tool for managing athlete pain, helping you to better understand its biopsychosocial dimensions.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter randomized controlled trial found that a smartphone-based digital therapeutic combining personalized exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy significantly reduced pain and improved function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心 RCT 表明，结合运动疗法和认知行为疗法的数字疗法，对慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛缓解和功能改善是有效且可规模化的。你可以在临床实践中考虑推荐这类数字工具，以提高患者依从性并解决心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: 结合运动与认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验发现，结合个性化运动和认知行为疗法的智能手机数字疗法，显著减轻了慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛，并改善了其功能、生活质量和心理健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter RCT shows that a digital therapeutic combining exercise therapy and cognitive-behavioral therapy is effective and scalable for pain reduction and functional improvement in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain. You can consider recommending such digital tools in your practice to enhance patient adherence and address psychosocial factors.
items.limitation: 研究的长期效果和经济效益尚待进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The long-term effects and cost-effectiveness of the intervention require further evaluation.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial showed that transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper-limb motor function (FMA-UE MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder and elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham stimulation.
items.curatedReason: taVNS 联合上肢运动可能是慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢功能恢复的新辅助手段。FMA-UE 提高 3.95 分（95% CI 0.21-7.69）虽达统计学显著，但需警惕其临床意义是否足以改变实践。鉴于样本量有限，现在就引入临床还为时过早，但值得后续更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）结合上肢运动训练，与假刺激相比，能显著改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）以及肩肘肌肉力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: taVNS combined with upper limb exercises might be a new adjunct for upper limb recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. While a 3.95-point FMA-UE improvement (95% CI 0.21-7.69) is statistically significant, question whether this truly translates to clinically meaningful changes. Given the limited sample size, it's too early to implement, but keep an eye on future larger trials.
items.limitation: FMA-UE 评分的 95% 置信区间低于报告的最小临床重要差异，其临床意义需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The 95% CI for FMA-UE score was below the reported minimal clinically important difference, so its clinical relevance should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance, including hop for distance, side-hop, and heel-raise, finding significant sex × age-group interactions for hop outcomes and males outperforming females in heel raises.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究首次为精英 TeamGym 体操运动员提供了下肢功能测试的性别和年龄特异性常模，弥补了该领域的数据空白。这些基准值对你评估运动员康复进展和重返运动能力，尤其是针对跳跃和提踵表现，有直接的指导意义。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模
items.summaryZh: 一项对 216 名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员进行的横断面研究，建立了下肢功能表现（包括跳远、侧跳和提踵）的性别和年龄特异性常模。研究发现，跳跃表现存在显著的性别×年龄组交互作用，且男性在提踵次数上优于女性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts, filling a data gap. These benchmarks directly guide your assessment of athlete rehabilitation progress and return-to-sport capability, especially for hop and heel-raise performance.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪运动员表现随时间的变化或评估这些常模预测损伤的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents tracking changes in athlete performance over time or evaluating the predictive validity of these norms for injury.

items.title: Graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort analysis of more than 10 000 football players who underwent ACL reconstruction found no association between graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) and the risk of revision ACLR among those who returned to competition, regardless of sex.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模全国性队列分析显示，在重返赛场的足球运动员中，ACL 重建术的移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次 ACL 重建的风险无关。这提示你在与运动员讨论移植物选择时，可以更多考虑患者特征和外科医生偏好，而不必过分强调移植物类型对再撕裂风险的影响。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员的再次 ACL 重建无关：一项全国性后续 ACL 重建队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对超过 10 000 名接受 ACL 重建术的足球运动员进行的全国性队列分析显示，在重返赛场的球员中，移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次 ACL 重建的风险无关，且男女均是如此。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large nationwide cohort analysis indicates that in football players returning to competition, the type of ACL reconstruction graft (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) is not associated with the risk of revision ACLR. This suggests that when discussing graft choice with athletes, you can prioritize patient characteristics and surgeon preference rather than overemphasizing the graft type's impact on re-tear risk.
items.limitation: 本研究只关注了再次 ACL 重建的风险，并未评估不同移植物类型对运动表现或长期关节健康的影响。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on the risk of revision ACLR and did not assess the impact of different graft types on athletic performance or long-term joint health.

items.title: Effect of Integrated Respiratory and Functional Training on Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation, Respiratory and Peripheral Muscle Strength, Functional Ability, and Pain After Emergency Abdominal Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of integrated respiratory and functional training on weaning from mechanical ventilation, respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, functional ability, and pain after emergency abdominal surgery.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 揭示，综合呼吸和功能训练对急腹症术后机械通气患者的撤机、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力及疼痛具有积极作用。你可以将这些训练方案整合进这类患者的 ICU 康复早期干预，以改善预后。
items.titleZh: 综合呼吸和功能训练对急腹症术后机械通气撤机、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力及疼痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了综合呼吸和功能训练对急腹症术后机械通气患者撤机、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力及疼痛的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT reveals that integrated respiratory and functional training positively impacts weaning from mechanical ventilation, respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, functional ability, and pain in patients after emergency abdominal surgery. You can integrate these training protocols into early ICU rehabilitation interventions for these patients to improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 原始摘要未提供关键效应量或 p 值，限制了对干预效果的量化评估。
items.limitationEn: The original abstract does not provide key effect sizes or p-values, limiting quantitative assessment of the intervention's impact.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in an Italian rehabilitation hospital explored neurorehabilitation patients' perceptions of fundamental care needs across physical, psychosocial, and relational dimensions, finding that patients valued care extending beyond technical tasks to include dignity, emotional support, and empathetic presence.
items.curatedReason: 仅仅关注运动功能恢复是不够的。患者真正看重的是超越技术任务的尊严、情感支持和同理心。在评估神经康复患者进展时，你必须把心理社会和关系维度纳入考量，否则会错过患者的核心需求。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待他们的基本护理需求？一项定性研究的发现
items.summaryZh: 一项在意大利康复医院进行的定性研究发现，神经康复患者对基本护理的需求涵盖身体、心理社会和关系维度，强调了护理不仅是技术性任务，更是关乎尊严、情感支持和同理心在场的有意义行为。
items.curatedReasonEn: Focusing solely on motor function isn't enough. Patients value dignity, emotional support, and empathetic presence beyond technical tasks. When assessing neurorehabilitation patients, you must include psychosocial and relational dimensions; otherwise, you'll miss their core needs.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性分析，样本量较小且在单一意大利康复医院进行，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size and was conducted in a single Italian rehabilitation hospital, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 older adults from the NHATS (2011-2024) found that a history of stroke was independently associated with a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38), highlighting pain as a substantial burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模横断面分析确认，卒中史是老年社区居民疼痛负担的重要独立预测因素，与困扰性疼痛 (OR 1.30) 和活动受限性疼痛 (OR 1.20) 均独立相关。这强化了你在老年卒中康复中，需要将疼痛评估和管理作为核心环节的认识。
items.titleZh: 社区居住型老年卒中患者与非卒中患者的困扰性与活动受限性疼痛：对国家健康与老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12,797 名老年人进行的横断面分析（NHATS, 2011-2024）发现，有卒中史的患者，困扰性疼痛（OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66）和活动受限性疼痛（OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）的患病率均显著更高，提示卒中对老年人疼痛负担有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cross-sectional analysis confirms that a history of stroke is a significant independent predictor of pain burden in community-dwelling older adults, independently associated with both bothersome pain (OR 1.30) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20). This reinforces the need for comprehensive pain assessment and management as a core component of geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法确立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系，且疼痛数据依赖于自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional analysis cannot establish causality between stroke and pain, and pain data relied on self-reports.

items.title: Time to act: why menopause should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine
items.summary: This editorial argues that menopause, defined as 12 consecutive months without a period, should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine due to its impact on physical performance, musculoskeletal pain, and overall health in female athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章指出，绝经期及其相关症状对女性运动员的表现和健康有显著影响。作为物理治疗师，你在评估和管理女性运动员（尤其是 45-56 岁年龄段）的运动损伤或表现下降时，应将绝经期视为一个重要的生物心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: 刻不容缓：为何应将绝经期作为运动医学的优先事项
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论认为，绝经期（定义为连续 12 个月无月经）应成为运动医学的优先关注点，因为它对女性运动员的身体表现、肌肉骨骼疼痛和整体健康有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that menopause and its related symptoms significantly impact female athletes' performance and health. As a physical therapist, you should consider menopause a crucial biopsychosocial factor when assessing and managing sports injuries or performance decline in female athletes, particularly those aged 45-56.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) developed a GRADE-based clinical practice guideline for rehabilitating athletes with hamstring strain injury, synthesizing evidence from randomized clinical trials.
items.curatedReason: 这份 GRADE 评级的腘绳肌拉伤指南基于最新的 RCT 证据。它可以作为你康复决策的可靠参考，尤其是针对巴西运动员，但需注意其文化和运动背景的适用性。
items.titleZh: 运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南
items.summaryZh: 巴西国家运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了一项基于 GRADE 的临床实践指南，旨在为运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复提供支持，综合了随机临床试验的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This GRADE-based guideline for hamstring strain injury is grounded in the latest RCT evidence. It serves as a reliable reference for your rehabilitation decisions, especially for Brazilian athletes, but consider its applicability to other cultural and athletic contexts.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: A theoretical framework proposes conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process (HODA-A), rather than isolated manual techniques, and applies COSMIN principles for its evaluation.
items.curatedReason: 手法评估（HODA-A）若要达到与患者报告结果测量（PROM）相当的严谨性，就必须应用 COSMIN 原则。你应当采纳这种测量学视角，重新审视和验证自己常用的手法评估手段。
items.titleZh: 将手法肌肉骨骼评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：应用 COSMIN 到 HODA-A 的理论框架
items.summaryZh: 一项理论框架提出将肌肉骨骼手法评估概念化为一种临床报告结果测量过程 (HODA-A)，而非孤立的手法技术，并应用 COSMIN 原则对其进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hands-on assessment (HODA-A) to achieve the same rigor as patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs), it must apply COSMIN principles. You should adopt this psychometric perspective to re-evaluate and validate the manual assessment techniques you commonly use.
items.limitation: 这是一篇理论性文章，尚无实证数据支持其提出的评估序列和框架。
items.limitationEn: This is a theoretical paper without empirical data to support its proposed assessment sequence and framework.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients found that thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF, all p < 0.001) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP, p < 0.001) compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴联合常规康复能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能和吸气肌力量，尤其在优化通气力学方面有优势。这提示你可以将胸部肌内效贴作为呼吸神经康复的实用辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的随机对照试验发现，胸部肌内效贴联合常规康复显著改善了肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF，均 p < 0.001）和吸气肌力量（MIP，p < 0.001），优于安慰剂贴扎。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia, particularly in optimizing ventilatory mechanics. This suggests you can consider thoracic KT as a practical adjunct in respiratory neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本单中心 RCT（30 名患者），且随访期较短，对长期效果的推断需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-center RCT (30 patients) with a short follow-up period, so long-term effects should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 81 cervicogenic headache patients found that both kinesio taping and myofascial release, combined with home exercise, effectively reduced pain and improved quality of life, with MFR showing more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life at one-month follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，肌内效贴 (KT) 和肌筋膜松解 (MFR) 联合家庭锻炼均能有效改善颈源性头痛。其中，MFR 在残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善，这表明 MFR 可能是颈源性头痛更优的长期康复策略。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴与肌筋膜松解疗法在颈源性头痛中的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 81 名颈源性头痛患者的随机对照试验发现，肌内效贴和肌筋膜松解疗法联合家庭锻炼均能有效减轻疼痛并改善生活质量，其中肌筋膜松解在为期一个月的随访中在残疾和身体生活质量方面显示出更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that both Kinesio Taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR), combined with home exercise, are effective for cervicogenic headache. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life, indicating it may be a superior long-term rehabilitation strategy for cervicogenic headache.
items.limitation: 随访期较短（1 个月），无法评估长期疗效；研究人群来自单一中心，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period was short (1 month), precluding assessment of long-term efficacy; the study population came from a single center, which may affect generalizability.

items.title: How does pre-stroke physical activity influence physical activity one year after minor stroke, and what role does cognitive impairment play?
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 100 minor stroke patients found that low pre-stroke physical activity was associated with 5.81 times higher odds of low physical activity 12 months post-stroke (95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p = 0.010), while the role of cognitive impairment remained inconclusive.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中前活动量低的患者在卒中 12 个月后更有可能持续不活跃（OR = 5.81）。将卒中前活动量纳入评估，有助于识别高风险患者并指导个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 卒中前身体活动如何影响轻度卒中后一年身体活动，以及认知障碍扮演何种角色？
items.summaryZh: 一项对 100 名轻度卒中患者的二次分析发现，卒中前身体活动水平较低的患者在卒中 12 个月后身体活动水平较低的几率高 5.81 倍（95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p = 0.010），而认知障碍的调节作用尚无定论。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that patients with low pre-stroke physical activity are significantly more likely to remain inactive 12 months post-stroke (OR = 5.81). Incorporating pre-stroke activity levels into your assessment can help identify high-risk patients and guide personalized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（100 名），且认知障碍的调节作用不确定性较高（95% CI: 0.81-89.9）。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (100 patients), and the modifying role of cognitive impairment showed high uncertainty (95% CI: 0.81-89.9).

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: A pilot study of "Let's Move," an early exercise program for hospitalized patients, found good adherence (76.5%) and safety among 26 participants, with 96.2% achieving individualized goals, supporting its feasibility and need for broader evaluation.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”是一个早期活动计划的初步探索，结果提示该计划在住院患者中具有可行性与安全性，依从性达 76.5%，96.2% 的参与者实现目标。虽然样本量仅为 26 人，但你可以借鉴其初步成果，考虑在你所在住院部启动更大型的早期活动项目。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计
items.summaryZh: 一项针对住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的试点研究发现，26 名参与者的依从性良好（76.5%）且安全，96.2% 的参与者实现了个体化目标，支持了其可行性并需进行更广泛的评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: The “Let's Move” pilot study suggests feasibility and safety for early exercise in hospitalized patients, with 76.5% adherence and 96.2% achieving goals. Although the sample size is small (26 participants), you can use these preliminary findings to consider initiating a larger early mobility program in your inpatient setting.
items.limitation: 试点研究样本量较小（26 名），且在单中心进行，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The pilot study had a small sample size (26 participants) and was conducted at a single center, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: A study found that a submaximal graded cycling exercise test up to vigorous intensity was well tolerated by mothers and fetuses in both singleton and twin pregnancies, with few differences in acute maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，中等至高强度运动对单胎和双胎妊娠的母胎心血管反应差异不大。这为更新双胎妊娠运动指南提供了高质量证据，支持你鼓励双胎孕妇在无禁忌症下保持活跃。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中等至高强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，单胎和双胎妊娠中，母亲和胎儿对亚最大分级循环运动测试至高强度的耐受性良好，母胎急性心血管反应差异不大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found few differences in maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies. This provides high-quality evidence to inform exercise advice for twin pregnancies, supporting your recommendation for active twin pregnant women without contraindications.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且运动测试在实验室环境下进行，可能无法完全反映日常活动的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and exercise testing was conducted in a laboratory setting, which may not fully reflect the effects of daily activities.

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study of 511 athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 found that 62% returned to sport at preinjury levels within 24 months post-primary ACL-R, with an average duration of 12.3 months (SD 4.7).
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性、基于注册的队列研究发现，ACL-R 术后高活跃运动员（Tegner ≥ 7）24 个月内重返运动（Tegner ≥ 7）的比例为 62%，平均需 12.3 个月。这为你制定术后康复计划和设定患者期望提供了现实数据。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后运动员重返运动：一项基于全国注册的纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 511 名术前 Tegner 活动量表 ≥ 7 分的运动员进行的全国性、基于注册的纵向队列研究发现，62% 的运动员在初次 ACL 重建术后 24 个月内恢复到术前运动水平，平均持续时间为 12.3 个月（SD 4.7）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study found that 62% of highly active athletes (Tegner ≥ 7) returned to sport (Tegner ≥ 7) within 24 months after primary ACL-R, with an average duration of 12.3 months. This provides realistic data for your post-operative rehabilitation planning and setting patient expectations.
items.limitation: 研究依靠患者自报数据和注册信息，可能存在回忆偏倚和数据完整性问题。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on patient-reported data and registry information, which may be subject to recall bias and data completeness issues.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes revealed pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations, leading to inconsistent guidance and heightened uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后阶段面临的独特挑战，包括教练和医疗服务提供者的知识不足。这提醒你，在为残疾运动员提供孕产期支持时，需要更专业的知识和适应性方案。
items.titleZh: 精英残疾运动员妊娠和产后经历的考察：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索精英残疾运动员妊娠和产后经历的定性研究揭示了教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织之间普遍存在的残疾特异性知识空白，导致指导不一致和不确定性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the unique challenges elite Para athletes face during pregnancy and postpartum, including knowledge gaps among coaches and healthcare providers. This underscores the need for more specialized knowledge and adaptive protocols when providing maternity support to Para athletes.
items.limitation: 定性研究样本量较小，结论的普遍性有限，且结果基于受访者的主观体验。
items.limitationEn: The qualitative study had a small sample size, limiting generalizability, and results were based on subjective experiences of interviewees.

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 12% of studies progressed to a definitive RCT, primarily due to lack of funding.
items.curatedReason: 中风康复领域，前瞻性试验的报告质量仍有待提高，并且仅有 12% 的可行性研究能进展到最终的随机对照试验。这提示你在评估新干预的前期证据时，要对研究设计和报告的质量保持警惕。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复领域的试点和可行性研究：报告质量、进展到试验的情况以及障碍：一项范围界定综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 项卒中康复领域试点和可行性研究的范围界定综述发现，报告质量平均为 6.1/11 分，且仅有 12% 的研究进展到明确的 RCT，主要原因是资金不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: In stroke rehabilitation, the reporting quality of pilot and feasibility studies needs improvement, with only 12% progressing to definitive RCTs. This indicates you should be cautious when evaluating early evidence for new interventions, paying close attention to study design and reporting quality.
items.limitation: 综述方法可能未覆盖所有相关的试点和可行性研究，特别是那些未发表或非英文的研究。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review methodology might not have covered all relevant pilot and feasibility studies, especially unpublished or non-English ones.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: The Georges Gymnastics Program, an inclusive school-based service for children with intellectual disability, partnered with an Olympic training center to scale its offerings, demonstrating a model for improving physical activity and fundamental movement skills.
items.curatedReason: Georges 体操项目通过与奥运训练中心合作，成功将针对智力障碍儿童的学校体操服务扩大规模。这展示了针对特定发育障碍儿童的包容性体育活动的可行模式和潜在益处，可作为社区康复项目的参考。
items.titleZh: Georges 体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作扩大针对智力障碍儿童的包容性校本体操服务
items.summaryZh: Georges 体操项目是一项针对智力障碍儿童的包容性校本服务，通过与奥运训练中心合作扩大了服务范围，展示了改善身体活动和基本运动技能的模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Georges Gymnastics Program successfully scaled an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training center partnership. This demonstrates a feasible model and potential benefits of inclusive sports activities for children with specific developmental disabilities, serving as a reference for community rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究主要描述项目设计和初步实施，缺乏对照组和长期疗效评估数据。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily describes program design and initial implementation, lacking control group and long-term efficacy evaluation data.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: A commentary highlights endometriosis as a striking blind spot in elite sports research, noting its chronic pain and fatigue symptoms may affect female athletes' training, performance, and quality of life, underscoring the need for more dedicated studies.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论指出，子宫内膜异位症在精英运动员研究中是一个显著的盲点，其症状可能影响训练和表现。它提醒你关注女性运动员中这种被忽视的慢性病，并倡导更多相关研究和支持。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究盲点
items.summaryZh: 一篇评论文章指出子宫内膜异位症是精英运动研究中的一个显著盲点，其慢性疼痛和疲劳症状可能影响女性运动员的训练、表现和生活质量，强调需要更多专门研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights endometriosis as a striking blind spot in elite athlete research, whose symptoms can impact training and performance. It urges you to pay attention to this overlooked chronic condition in female athletes and advocates for more related research and support.
items.limitation: 这是一篇评论性文章，不提供新的研究数据或临床证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary piece and does not provide new research data or clinical evidence.

items.title: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summary: A preliminary validation study of the Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) in 78 patients with voice disorders demonstrated emerging content, construct, concurrent, and predictive validity, supporting its use for increased clarity in stimulability testing documentation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究初步验证了用于声音障碍患者多维刺激性测试评定量表（MSP-V）的有效性，为言语病理学家提供了更精细的评估工具。对物理治疗师来说，这提示了在其他康复领域开发类似多维评估工具的潜力。
items.titleZh: 声音障碍患者多维刺激性测试评定量表的初步验证
items.summaryZh: 一项对 78 名声音障碍患者进行的多维刺激性声音档案（MSP-V）评定量表的初步验证研究表明，该量表具有内容、结构、并发和预测效度，支持其在刺激性测试记录中提供更高清晰度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers preliminary validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) rating scale for patients with voice disorders, providing speech-language pathologists with a more refined assessment tool. For physical therapists, this suggests the potential for developing similar multidimensional assessment tools in other rehabilitation fields.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅是初步验证，需要进一步在不同人群中进行大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size and provided only preliminary validation, requiring further large-scale validation in diverse populations.

items.title: Feasibility and Measurement Properties of a Large Language Model-Based Virtual Patient Laboratory for Clinical Reasoning Training in Physical Therapy Students: Single-Arm Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with 27 physical therapy students found a large language model-based virtual patient lab feasible for clinical reasoning training, but LLM-generated clinical judgment ratings clustered near the maximum and did not reflect human assessor ratings with a real patient.
items.curatedReason: 本研究发现，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的虚拟患者实验室在物理治疗学生临床推理训练中的可行性良好，但 LLM 生成的评分与人类评估的真实患者表现相关性不强。这提示你在使用 AI 工具进行教学和评估时，要警惕其评分的有效性，仍需人类专家校准。
items.titleZh: 基于大型语言模型的虚拟患者实验室在物理治疗学生临床推理训练中的可行性与测量特性：单臂试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 27 名物理治疗学生的试点研究发现，基于大型语言模型的虚拟患者实验室在临床推理训练中是可行的，但 LLM 生成的临床判断评分集中在最高分附近，且未能反映人类评估者对真实患者的评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that a large language model (LLM)-based virtual patient lab was feasible for clinical reasoning training in physical therapy students, but LLM-generated ratings did not strongly correlate with human assessments of real patient performance. This cautions you to be wary of the validity of AI-generated scores when using AI tools for teaching and assessment, still requiring human expert calibration.
items.limitation: 研究发现 LLM 生成的评分普遍偏高且与真实患者表现的相关性不足，限制了其作为评估工具的有效性。
items.limitationEn: The study found that LLM-generated ratings were generally high and showed insufficient correlation with real patient performance, limiting their effectiveness as an assessment tool.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review found no clear association between reduced spinal ROM and outcomes for various spinal pain conditions, with consistently very low certainty of evidence and high risk of bias across studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述表明，在各种脊柱疼痛病症中，脊柱活动度（ROM）受限并非预测疼痛强度、功能障碍或康复情况的明确因素。现有证据的确定性极低，且所有纳入研究均存在高偏倚风险，因此不应将ROM受限作为唯一的预后指标。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度下降是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和总体恢复的预测因素吗？一项系统评价
items.titleEn: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统评价发现，对于各种脊柱疼痛患者，脊柱活动度下降与疼痛强度、残疾或恢复之间没有明确的关联，所有研究的证据确定性都非常低，且偏倚风险很高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that reduced spinal range of motion (ROM) is not a clear prognostic factor for pain intensity, disability, or recovery in various spinal pain conditions. The evidence certainty was consistently very low across all included studies, all of which had a high risk of bias.
items.limitation: 所有 37 项研究均存在高偏倚风险，证据确定性一致非常低。
items.limitationEn: All 37 included studies were rated as having a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was consistently very low.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and depressive symptoms compared to usual care in this RCT.
items.curatedReason: 6个月的线上康复训练（Pilates+筋膜放松）显著改善了纤维肌痛患者的症状和睡眠，别再依赖线下常规治疗了。
items.titleZh: 结合普拉提治疗性锻炼和自我筋膜松解术的六个月监督远程康复治疗对纤维肌痛症患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六个月的监督性远程康复项目，结合了普拉提为基础的锻炼和自我筋膜松解术，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的影响、睡眠质量和心理结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care.
items.limitation: 未评估 6 个月以上远期疗效，焦虑结果未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: Long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed, and anxiety outcomes did not show significant improvement.

items.title: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summary: This study found dysphagia in frail older adults is linked to decreased physical performance (SPPB) and increased fall risk, highlighting the need for routine swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究发现，虚弱老年人的吞咽困难与身体机能下降（SPPB 评分较低）和跌倒风险增加显著相关。这意味着在老年病护理中，常规进行吞咽评估至关重要，不应忽视吞咽功能对整体健康和安全的影响。
items.titleZh: 吞咽困难与衰弱老年人身体机能及跌倒风险的关联
items.titleEn: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，衰弱老年人的吞咽困难与其较差的身体机能（SPPB 评分降低）和较高的跌倒风险显著相关，强调了在老年护理中进行吞咽评估的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that dysphagia in frail older adults is significantly associated with poorer physical performance (lower SPPB scores) and increased fall risk, underscoring the importance of swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性研究，样本量相对较小（109 例）。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with a relatively small sample size (109 patients).

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review found very low certainty evidence for dextrose prolotherapy in chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy/bursitis, with potential for little to no benefit compared to saline and worse performance than corticosteroids, highlighting the need for high-quality RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性肩袖肌腱病/滑囊炎，这项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，葡萄糖增生疗法的证据确定性极低，它与生理盐水相比可能几乎没有益处，且与皮质类固醇注射相比，运动表现可能更差。目前急需高质量的随机对照试验（RCT）来验证其临床价值。
items.titleZh: 注射用糊精治疗慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.titleEn: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统评价发现，注射用糊精治疗慢性肩袖肌腱病/滑囊炎的证据确定性极低，与生理盐水相比益处甚微或无益，与皮质类固醇注射相比可能导致体能表现下降，凸显了高质量RCT的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis found very low certainty evidence for dextrose prolotherapy in rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis. It may offer little to no benefit compared to saline and potentially worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections. High-quality RCTs are needed.
items.limitation: 证据确定性极低，多数研究偏倚风险高，且规模小、随访期短。
items.limitationEn: The evidence certainty was very low, with most included studies having a high risk of bias and being small and short-term.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In knee osteoarthritis, this RCT found MI-RT superior for quadriceps strength, while passive BFR at 70% LOP improved functional ability more than MI-RT with less exertion, presenting a feasible alternative.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎，本 RCT 发现中等强度抗阻训练（MI-RT）对股四头肌力量最有效。但被动血流限制训练（BFR）在 70% LOP 下，以更小的感知劳累度，在功能改善方面优于 MI-RT，这意味着 BFR 是 MI-RT 不耐受患者的一个可行替代方案。
items.titleZh: 不同负荷下的血流限制与中等强度抗阻训练对膝关节骨关节炎患者的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，在中度强度抗阻训练（MI-RT）对膝关节骨关节炎患者股四头肌力量最有效的情况下，70% LOP 的被动血流限制（BFR）在较低的感知劳累度下改善了下肢功能能力，使其成为无法耐受 MI-RT 患者的可行选择。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT) most effective for quadriceps strength in knee osteoarthritis, while passive BFR at 70% LOP yielded greater improvements in functional ability with less perceived exertion, making it a feasible option for those who can't tolerate MI-RT.
items.limitation: 50% LOP 的被动 BFR 相比其他干预措施，功能改善较小。
items.limitationEn: Passive BFR at 50% LOP showed smaller functional improvements than the other interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review debunks the heel-strike fallacy and the universal 180 steps/min cadence belief in running, emphasizing individualized adjustments based on specific goals.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述批驳了跑步中“脚跟着地有害”的误解和“每分钟 180 步是普适步频”的信条，强调跑步姿势和步频应根据个体目标进行调整。这意味着我们不应盲目遵循普遍建议，而应根据患者具体情况和目标来指导跑步训练。
items.titleZh: 后足触地谬误与跑者步频信念：一项叙述性综述
items.titleEn: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述挑战了长跑中常见的信念，指出后足触地并非固有危害，180步/分钟并非普遍最优步频，且改变应基于个体目标而非普遍性标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review challenges common beliefs in distance running, stating that rearfoot striking is not inherently harmful, 180 steps/min is not universally optimal cadence, and that changes should be based on individual goals rather than generalized targets.
items.limitation: 本文为叙述性综述，不呈现新的实证数据；建议基于现有文献综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review and does not present new empirical data; recommendations are based on synthesizing existing literature.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed approach to prioritize exercise for frail older adults, matching interventions to dominant physiological limitations like weakness, breathlessness, or instability.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于指导虚弱老年人的运动优先级。它建议针对虚弱主要采用抗阻训练，针对呼吸困难主要采用有氧训练，针对步态不稳主要采用平衡训练，并将多成分运动作为默认选择。这意味着你应根据患者最主要的生理限制来制定个性化运动方案。
items.titleZh: 衰弱症的运动优先化：针对老年人康复的病理生理学知识整合型叙述性综述
items.titleEn: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述为衰弱老年人运动优先化提供了一个基于病理生理学知识的框架，建议针对虚弱进行抗阻训练，针对气短进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练，并以多组分运动作为默认选项。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review provides a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercises in frail older adults, suggesting resistance training for weakness, aerobic for breathlessness, and balance for gait instability, with multicomponent exercise as the default.
items.limitation: 仍需在衰弱人群中进行直接试验，以测试此优先处方模型。
items.limitationEn: Direct trials specifically in frailty-defined populations testing this prioritized prescription model are still needed.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: This podcast explores AI's impact on physical therapy practice and payment, discussing its potential to reduce administrative tasks and improve patient care time.
items.curatedReason: AI 的影响已不限于理论，它正在实实在在地改变物理治疗的实践和支付模式。听完这期，你会明白 AI 如何减轻行政负担、优化工作流程，并最终让你有更多时间投入到患者护理中，这才是真正的价值所在。
items.titleZh: 探索人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响
items.titleEn: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summaryZh: 这期播客探讨了人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响，重点介绍了其在减轻行政负担、改进工作流程和增加患者护理时间方面的潜力，并汇集了行业领导者的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This podcast episode discusses how AI is impacting physical therapist practice and payment, focusing on reducing administrative burden, improving workflows, and enhancing patient care time, with insights from industry leaders.
items.limitation: 本期播客讨论了应用和误解，而非实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a podcast episode discussing applications and misconceptions, not empirical research.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summary: Physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district report significant barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders, including inadequate training and resources, leading to infrequent patient care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 地区的物理治疗师在处理盆底疾病（PFD）时面临的严重障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅。这意味着该地区患者很少能得到有效的 PFD 管理，凸显了资源和培训的迫切需求。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底障碍的经验
items.titleEn: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 区的物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFDs）方面面临重大障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅，导致患者管理频率低下。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district face significant barriers in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs), including limited undergraduate training, understaffing, and poor referral pathways, resulting in infrequent patient management.
items.limitation: 研究集中于南非特定地区，限制了其推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on a specific district in South Africa, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 63 sources mapped relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation, primarily in multiple sclerosis and stroke. Interventions were feasible and well-accepted, with outcomes mainly assessed for psychological functioning at the body structure/function level, highlighting gaps in less prevalent conditions and activity/participation outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 放松干预在神经康复中应用广泛，但在多发性硬化和卒中之外的其他疾病、以及生理应激、活动和参与等结局方面，证据仍有较大空白。评估放松干预时，请注意其主要效果仍集中在心理功能层面。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中放松干预的范围界定综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖63篇文献的范围界定综述梳理了神经康复中的放松干预，主要集中于多发性硬化和卒中患者。干预措施可行且接受度高，但主要在身体结构和功能层面评估心理功能结局，提示在不常见疾病和活动/参与结局方面存在研究空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: While relaxation interventions are widely used in neurological rehabilitation, significant evidence gaps remain for conditions beyond MS and stroke, as well as for outcomes beyond psychological functioning, such as physiological stress, activity, and participation. When evaluating relaxation interventions, note that their primary effects are still concentrated on psychological function.
items.limitation: 本综述识别出证据异质性高、缺乏比较有效性研究和定性设计等局限。
items.limitationEn: This review identified limitations including high evidence heterogeneity, lack of comparative effectiveness studies, and qualitative designs.
