items.title: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summary: Directional EMG mapping revealed that severe stroke survivors have disrupted upper-limb force control with direction-specific deficits and compensatory strategies correlated with impairment severity.
items.curatedReason: 利用定向肌电图（EMG）标测技术，本研究发现重度中风幸存者上肢力量控制存在紊乱，表现为方向特异性缺陷和补偿策略，且这些与损伤严重程度相关。这意味着评估上肢功能时，需要考虑这些方向性障碍及其对日常活动的影响。
items.titleZh: 方向性肌电图模式揭示了卒中后上肢力控制中与损伤相关的中断
items.titleEn: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summaryZh: 一项使用方向性肌电图绘制的研究发现，严重受损的卒中幸存者表现出上肢力控制中断，其方向特异性缺陷和代偿策略与损伤严重程度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study using directional EMG mapping found that stroke survivors with severe impairment exhibit disrupted upper-limb force control, with direction-specific deficits and compensatory strategies that correlate with impairment severity.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（仅 8 名慢性卒中幸存者），且为回顾性注册。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (8 chronic stroke survivors) and was retrospectively registered.

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review found limited evidence on WBV and LSE for postural control in flexible flatfoot, with most data from related populations and a call for RCTs specifically in FF.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查发现，在柔韧性扁平足（FF）患者中，全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定运动（LSE）对姿势控制的证据有限，现有数据多来自相关人群。这意味着在 FF 人群中，我们急需设计良好的随机对照试验（RCT）来验证这些干预措施的有效性。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰椎稳定练习对姿势控制的证据映射：一项针对弹性平足的范围审查
items.titleEn: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summaryZh: 这项范围审查发现，关于全身振动（WBV）和腰椎稳定练习（LSE）对弹性平足（FF）姿势控制的研究证据有限，大部分证据来自相关人群，并且迫切需要针对 FF 人群设计良好的 RCT。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found limited evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF), with most evidence from related populations and a need for well-designed RCTs in the FF population.
items.limitation: 在 FF 中仅识别出两项直接干预研究，均未评估 WBV 或 LSE，因此有效性仍不确定。
items.limitationEn: Only two direct intervention studies in FF were identified, neither evaluating WBV or LSE, thus effectiveness remains uncertain.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) combined with conventional physical therapy led to significantly greater improvements in upper-limb motor function (ARAT scores increased by 12.05 and 12.44 points respectively, P < .001) compared to conventional physical therapy alone in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者的手功能恢复，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电图引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 都比单纯常规物理治疗效果更好，但两者之间没有显著差异。在设计手功能康复方案时，不必纠结于这两种电刺激技术的选择，可优先考虑患者依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中手功能恢复疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，结合常规物理治疗的感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）均能显著改善上肢运动功能（ARAT 评分分别增加 12.05 和 12.44 分，P < .001），效果优于单独的常规物理治疗，但 SES 与 Alt-EMG 之间没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hand function recovery in chronic stroke patients, both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) are superior to conventional physical therapy alone, but there is no significant difference between the two. When designing hand rehabilitation programs, focus on patient adherence and equipment availability rather than overthinking the choice between these two electrical stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 60 人，随访期为 12 周，可能限制了长期效应和在不同卒中阶段的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 60 participants with a 12-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and applicability across different stroke stages.

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study of 14 women explored patient experiences with physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction in Sweden, finding that it served as a "complementary piece of a puzzle" by enabling equity and improving accessibility, but also highlighting concerns about the absence of physical examination and hands-on guidance.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复是产后盆底功能障碍的有效补充模式，能提升可及性和依从性。但远程模式仍有局限性，例如无法进行体格检查和手把手指导。考虑采用混合模式，将远程和线下诊疗结合，以提供更个性化的康复服务。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍物理治疗远程康复患者体验的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对 14 名瑞典女性进行的定性研究探讨了产后盆底功能障碍患者的物理治疗远程康复体验。研究发现远程康复是“一块补充性拼图”，能提高公平性和可及性，但也凸显了患者对缺乏体格检查和手把手指导的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation is an effective complementary model for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, improving accessibility and adherence. However, the remote format still has limitations, such as the inability to perform physical examinations and hands-on guidance. Consider a hybrid model combining remote and in-person care to provide more personalized rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（14 名参与者），结果的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (14 participants), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: This process evaluation, using semi-structured interviews and a focus group with 13 patients and 4 physiotherapists, found that the Enhanced Rehabilitation after Major Trauma Programme (ERP) for survivors of the Manchester Arena bombing was viewed as a valuable, structured, multidisciplinary approach, but raised concerns about sustaining progress and transitioning back to standard NHS care.
items.curatedReason: 针对重大创伤患者，结构化、多学科康复方案（如曼彻斯特爆炸案后的 ERP）显著优于标准 NHS 康复。但注意长期康复的可持续性与资源限制。在临床实践中，可借鉴其多学科协作和个性化设计理念，但要为患者后续转介和支持做好规划。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案严重肌肉骨骼损伤患者强化康复项目的过程评估：调查患者和物理治疗师的经验
items.summaryZh: 这项对曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案幸存者的强化康复项目（ERP）进行的过程评估，通过与 13 名患者和 4 名物理治疗师的半结构化访谈和焦点小组讨论发现，ERP 被视为有价值的、结构化的多学科方法，但也引发了对其进展可持续性和回归标准 NHS 护理的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: For major trauma patients, structured, multidisciplinary rehabilitation programs like ERP (from the Manchester Arena bombing) are significantly better than standard NHS rehabilitation. Be mindful of long-term sustainability and resource constraints. In practice, adopt its multidisciplinary collaboration and personalized design principles, but plan for patient referrals and ongoing support.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（13 名患者和 4 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (13 patients and 4 physiotherapists), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.

items.title: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summary: This observational cohort study (N=1683) found that post-stroke patients with a first EHR-documented aggression (18.8%) had a 2.83/1000 patient-day incidence, 8.1% 30-day and 15.6% 60-day risks, longer LOS (+17.9 days), and poorer mFIM outcomes compared to nonaggressive patients, suggesting a 60-day precaution window for planning.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后首次出现攻击行为是一个重要的规划信号，提示患者在 60 天内发生其他不良事件（如跌倒、尿路感染）的风险较高，且住院时间更长、功能预后更差。在评估和制定康复计划时，应将此作为危险信号，调整目标设置和出院日期预期，并加强风险管理。
items.titleZh: 首次攻击行为作为卒中急性期后康复的规划信号：来自综合观察队列的服务基准、目标设定和 60 天预防窗口
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性队列研究（N=1683）发现，卒中后首次出现电子健康记录记载的攻击行为的患者（18.8%）发生率为 2.83/1000 患者日，30 天和 60 天风险分别为 8.1% 和 15.6%，且与无攻击行为患者相比，住院时间更长（+17.9 天），运动功能独立性评定（mFIM）结果更差，提示在规划时应设置 60 天预防窗口。
items.curatedReasonEn: The first aggressive behavior after stroke is an important planning signal, indicating a higher risk of other adverse events (e.g., falls, UTIs) within 60 days, longer hospital stays, and poorer functional outcomes. Integrate this into your assessment and rehabilitation planning as a red flag, adjusting goal setting and discharge date expectations, and enhancing risk management.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性队列研究，尽管进行了倾向匹配，但仍无法完全排除混杂因素，且是单中心数据，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational cohort study, despite propensity matching, cannot fully exclude confounders and is based on single-center data, potentially limiting generalizability.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes (cognition, mood, anxiety, fatigue) through three reviews at 1, 3, and 6 months, showing potential to address gaps in UK post-stroke care.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后轻中度认知、情绪、焦虑和疲劳改变的患者提供了监测和自我管理支持，可作为英国卒中社区护理的补充。这提示我们可以关注此类患者的心理变化，并考虑将类似简短干预整合到常规康复路径中，尤其在资源有限的社区环境中。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目的开发：一项复杂干预，旨在匹配护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目是一项旨在通过在 1、3 和 6 个月进行三次评估，监测和支持卒中后心理变化（认知、情绪、焦虑、疲劳）自我管理的简短干预措施，有望弥补英国卒中后护理的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers monitoring and self-management support for post-stroke patients with mild-to-moderate cognitive, mood, anxiety, and fatigue changes, complementing UK stroke community care. This suggests focusing on such psychological changes in patients and integrating similar brief interventions into standard rehabilitation pathways, especially in resource-limited community settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项复杂干预措施的设计和开发报告，尚未进行临床有效性测试，其效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This is a report on the design and development of a complex intervention, with clinical effectiveness testing still planned, so its impact is not yet clear.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review highlights shifts in ACL reconstruction toward quadriceps tendon autografts and lateral augmentation for high-risk knees. It emphasizes that return-to-play decisions should be criteria-based, combining time from surgery, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, given that limb symmetry index may overestimate recovery and psychological readiness independently impacts re-injury risk.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的康复和重返运动评估，已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估。未来 ACLR 患者的重返运动方案，应结合手术时间、功能标准和心理准备度进行综合判断。特别注意患者心理准备度对重返运动和二次损伤风险的独立影响。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、外侧增强、康复和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 本综述重点介绍了前交叉韧带重建术向股四头肌腱自体移植和高危膝关节外侧增强的转变。它强调重返运动的决定应基于标准，结合术后时间、功能标准和心理准备，因为肢体对称指数可能高估恢复程度，且心理准备独立影响再次受伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-ACLR rehabilitation and return-to-play assessment have shifted from fixed timelines to criteria-based evaluation. Future return-to-play protocols for ACLR patients should integrate surgical time, functional criteria, and psychological readiness. Pay particular attention to the independent impact of psychological readiness on return-to-sport and second injury risk.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，信息整合可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏系统的证据评估方法。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, and information synthesis may be subject to selection bias, lacking systematic evidence evaluation methods.

items.title: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study in Japan found that the provision of weekend rehabilitation services was significantly associated with early rehabilitation initiation (incidence rate ratio 1.65) in 17,194 acute ischemic stroke patients, while therapist staffing levels and stroke volume were not.
items.curatedReason: 这项日本研究显示，急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复的启动率主要受医院层面的系统性因素影响，特别是周末康复服务的提供。如果你希望提高早期康复启动率，应考虑优化排班和资源配置以支持周末服务。
items.titleZh: 医院层面因素与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动的关联：一项日本农村县行政数据库的多水平分析
items.summaryZh: 一项在日本进行的多中心横断面研究发现，提供周末康复服务与 17,194 名急性缺血性卒中患者的早期康复启动显著相关（发生率比 1.65），而治疗师人员配备和卒中量则无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Japanese study indicates that early rehabilitation initiation for acute ischemic stroke patients is largely influenced by hospital-level systemic factors, especially the provision of weekend rehabilitation services. If you aim to improve early rehabilitation initiation rates, consider optimizing scheduling and resource allocation to support weekend services.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，未能确立因果关系，且数据来自日本一个农村县的行政数据库，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and its reliance on an administrative database from a rural Japanese prefecture limits generalizability.

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial posits telerehabilitation as a necessary evolution for musculoskeletal physical therapy, not as a replacement for traditional care but as a means to extend the therapist's role through continuous monitoring, communication, education, and patient engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，远程康复不是面对面治疗的替代品，而是物理治疗师通过连续监测、沟通和患者教育来延伸其角色的方式，认识到这能拓展你的服务边界。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必然演进
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评认为远程康复是肌肉骨骼物理治疗的必然演进，它不是传统治疗的替代，而是通过连续监测、沟通、教育和患者参与来拓展治疗师角色的方式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that telerehabilitation isn't a replacement for in-person therapy but rather an extension of the physical therapist's role through continuous monitoring, communication, and patient education. Recognize how this can expand your service reach.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 16,783 participants with traumatic spinal cord injury found that lower time-updated social integration scores (HR 1.09) and within-person declines (HR 1.077) were associated with higher subsequent all-cause mortality, observed across natural and external causes.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，较低的社会融合度及其下降趋势与更高的死亡风险相关。在康复计划中，要警惕社会融合度的变化，这能作为预后信息的参考点，但目前证据不足以指导你直接干预社会融合来改变生存率。
items.titleZh: 时间变化性社会融合与创伤性脊髓损伤后长期全因和特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16,783 名创伤性脊髓损伤患者的纵向研究发现，较低的社会融合度（HR 1.09）和个体内下降（HR 1.077）与随后的全因死亡率升高相关，涵盖自然和外部原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with traumatic spinal cord injury, lower and declining social integration scores are associated with higher mortality risk. Be aware of changes in social integration as a prognostic indicator within rehabilitation programs, but the current evidence is insufficient to guide direct interventions on social integration to alter survival rates.
items.limitation: 研究未明确建立社会融合度干预与生存率改善的因果关系，且存在幸存者选择偏差和部分死亡原因数据缺失。
items.limitationEn: The study did not establish a causal link between social integration interventions and improved survival, and limitations include survivor selection bias and missing cause-of-death data.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
